details.report:
Committed forward repair `5596df1` with a clean current worktree.

Census and repair:
- Reviewer scope production census found exactly two prompt sinks: the parent `before_agent_start` construction in `src/reviewer-role.ts` and the real child resource-loader construction in `src/reviewer-agent.ts`. Both now use the single owner seam `src/reviewer-scope-prompt.ts`.
- The shared representation hex-encodes every UTF-16 code unit per key, preserving exact identity and key boundaries while allowing only fixed JSON syntax and lowercase hex inside the prompt envelope. Absence still emits the unchanged full-review marker; parsing, grammar, uniqueness, and normalization behavior were untouched.
- The real-parent oracle round-trips delimiter forging, quotes, backslashes, actual controls, literal escape-looking text, case, and leading whitespace. The real two-child sibling batch verifies every child receives the shared safe representation and cannot forge a full-scope section.
- README census covered the canonical Fixer output and Judge verdict sections plus their composition text. The canonical examples now show legal status-dependent Judge/Fixer typed shapes and constraints while preserving caller-owned reconciliation/topology and making no routing, repetition, mandatory-Judge, or package-owned reconciliation claim.

Evidence:
- Focused: `node --import tsx --test test/reviewer-role.test.ts test/reviewer-agent.test.ts test/class-contracts.test.ts` — 29/29 passed.
- Package lifecycle after adding the shared packaged source: 1/1 passed.
- `npm run typecheck` — passed.
- Final `npm test` — 373/373 passed.
- `git diff --check` — passed; current HEAD is `5596df18afc8d1eb6c036938844d0f1f69f5c8f5`; worktree clean.

No Judge findings were left unadopted and no non-goal surfaces were changed.
